name: Rear selectable locker
_note: An open rear diff the driver can lock: both rear wheels turn together, so one on ice or in the air can't take all the drive.

differential._note: type: 'open' (equal torque to both wheels, so the lighter one can spin up), 'locked' (both wheels at the same speed) or 'lsd' (clutch-type limited slip: it resists a speed difference with up to preload + lock × the torque going through it, N·m). lockable: the driver can lock it (a selectable locker). torqueSteer: on a driven front axle, how much of the car's torque steer gets through.
